mission_07: Excellent analytical work! You have built a comprehensive benchmark comparing five major outlier detection methods using precision, recall, and F1 score. This systematic evaluation reveals that no single method dominates across all scenarios, and the best choice depends on the specific characteristics of your data and the relative costs of false positives versus false negatives. IQR and Z-score provide simple, interpretable baselines but are limited to univariate or parametric settings. Isolation Forest offers a good balance of accuracy and efficiency for general-purpose use. DBSCAN and LOF excel when density structure is important. This comparative framework should be your go-to approach when selecting an outlier detection method for any new dataset.
